prompt: Create an animated VFX sprite sheet: a MONUMENTAL SPECTRAL FOREST SHIELD rising from the ground. The shield: a tall heavy kite shield of dark green stone-wood seen in three-quarter view facing screen-right, a worn gold tree crest in its centre, solid gold antler-shaped corners, a glowing jade rim, semi-solid and weighty (not glassy). GROUND ANCHOR: its bottom tip rests on one fixed point, horizontally centred, at 94% of the cell height; at full size it fills 86% of the cell height. Frame 1: a ring of dust and the shield's top just breaking out of the ground (25% height). Frame 2: rising (60%). Frame 3: full size, dust falling off. Frame 4: full size, the crest shining. Frame 5: full size, steady. Frame 6: full size, a bright pulse through the crest (the stomp). Frame 7: full size, leaning forward as if about to charge. Frame 8: full size, leaning forward further, jade light streaming back from its edges. LAYOUT: exactly eight frames in a 2 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS grid of equal square cells, tall 1024x2048 canvas, read left-to-right, top-to-bottom, one continuous one-shot effect. Clean HD painterly anime game VFX matching a chibi fantasy RPG, NOT pixel art; everything painted fully opaque with crisp shapes (no soft haze, no smoke, no translucent fog). No character, no creature, no hero, no weapon, no text, no labels, no borders, no grid lines, no ground plate, no floor, no shadow. Everything stays fully inside its own cell with at least 6% magenta padding on all four sides in every frame. Background 100% solid flat #FF00FF magenta, no gradient. Never use magenta, pink or purple in the effect.

precheck.summary: The sheet has eight frames in a 2x4 grid on a flat #FF00FF background, with no visible text, borders, extra figures, or cropping of the shield. The shield keeps its gold tree crest and antler corners across frames. The only deviation is that the green streaks in the leaning frames come within about 2 to 3% of the cell edge, short of the requested 6% magenta padding, which is a minor layout note rather than a clear defect.
